messages:
Alejandra: billing alarm - unexpected $35,200 in the last 3h on billing dashboard https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/000000000000 — tagging eng-infra, looks like autoscaler runaway?

InfraBot: Budget alert: project-redwood-prod exceeded threshold (threshold: $5k/hr) at 2026-03-17T14:22Z

Mike: looking. which cluster/region?

Alejandra: us-west1 (gke-prod cluster) — cost center breakdown shows compute.googleapis.com/instance: majority coming from instance type a2-highgpu-8. We don't have committed use discounts for the a2 family in this region.

Sam: checking k8s — `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep a2` shows 18 nodes a2-highgpu-8, lots of pods Pending. cluster-autoscaler logs: `I0323 14:09:31 scale_up.go:... ScaleUp: group gpu-pool-v2, delta=12` — it kicked off a big scale up for 120 pending pods.

Tina: I just merged terraform change (PR #2345) ~40m ago that updated node pool template. Looks like `var.gpu_machine_family` defaulted to "a2" instead of the intended "t4" family due to an interpolation bug.

Mike: can we pause or cap autoscaling? set max to current nodes immediately.

Tina: patched autoscaler settings to cap at 18 nodes and temporarily disabled autoscaling on the pool via gcloud. Command I ran: `gcloud container node-pools update gpu-pool-v2 --cluster=prod --zone=us-west1-b --enable-autoscaling --max-nodes=18 --min-nodes=18`

Sam: cordoned the offending nodes and started draining non-critical workloads: `kubectl cordon node/a2-...` then `kubectl drain node/a2-... --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Will throttle rollout to avoid another surge.

Ryan: running billing export query now — preliminary: a2 instance cost in last 3h ≈ $33,900. Quick sanity check: a2-highgpu-8 on-demand ~ $9–$10/hr * 18 ≈ $1.8k–$1.9k/hr, matches the spike.

Alejandra: action plan: rollback PR #2345 to restore t4 template (Tina), put autoscaler on hold (Tina/Sam), and open a postmortem to capture root cause + mitigations. Also follow up on committed use/reserved capacity options for t4s in us-west1.

Tina: rolling back PR now and starting node pool recreation with correct machine type. Autoscaler remains paused until pool stable.

InfraBot: Deploy bot: terraform apply completed for module "gke_node_pools" (plan: 2 to change, 1 to destroy) at 2026-03-17T15:05Z

Sam: I'll draft the incident note. We should add a CI guardrail to block machine_family changes on GPU pools without an explicit approval step.

Mike: +1. Also add a realtime billing rule: alert when spend from a single instance family > $5k/hr for a project/cluster.

Alejandra: agreed. Thanks everyone — monitoring shows spend trending down after draining and cap. Will confirm once billing exports finish. If any a2 nodes come back up unexpectedly, ping me immediately.

Ryan: logged follow-up tasks in #eng-infra-ops: rollback confirmation, CI guardrail, billing alert, postmortem.

Tina: apology for the slip, will add an extra test in terraform plan checks to catch defaults not explicitly set. :grimacing:
